name: Wikipedia
goodFor: A lead paragraph and a picture for almost any term, and what a topic covers.
attribution: The article's title, a link to the article, and the licence name (CC BY-SA 4.0).
access: https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/{title} for an app; node tools/ref.mjs wikipedia "<title>" for an agent.

checked.basis: secondary sources and Creative Commons' compatible-licences page; Wikimedia's own terms not opened

notes: An app may show an extract with credit. The bank is CC0 and can't carry share-alike text, so agents read a page to learn what a topic covers and never copy its wording (pipeline/prompts/sources.md). Pictures carry their own licence, file by file. Articles often read above introductory level.
